display_long_description:
Step into Zombie Kill Zone VR, a fast-paced virtual reality survival shooter built around direct weapon interaction, close-range danger, and escalating zombie encounters. Explore the battlefield, pick up weapons, and defend yourself as zombies spawn around the terrain and chase you down using aggressive attack behavior.
Every hit matters. Your health is tracked during the run, and the game ends when the undead overwhelm you. Take down as many zombies as possible, survive longer, and compete for a place on the leaderboard with your best kill score.
Designed for VR, Zombie Kill Zone VR focuses on physical presence, responsive combat, atmospheric zombie audio, and simple replayable survival gameplay. Grab your weapon, stay alert, and see how long you can hold the kill zone.
